caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with four legs and a decorative back panel that features three rectangular extensions of varying heights, the middle one being the tallest and adorned with a carved "X" pattern. The chest has three wide drawers, each with two round brass or gold-colored knobs, and a keyhole in the center of each drawer. The wood on the drawer fronts has a lighter, wavy grain pattern, while the sides and decorative columns on the front are of a darker shade. The legs are turned and bulbous in shape, and there are vertical columns on either side of the drawers with a chevron pattern at the top. The chest is set against a light, plain background.
title: Chest of Drawers
